blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY— Kanlaon Volcano on Negros Island had a moderately explosive eruption on Saturday, October 10, sending an ash plume above its summit, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). Phivolcs, in an advisory, said the eruption began shortly before 12:30 p.m. and ended at 12:48 p.m. READ: EXPLAINER: How did the Kanlaon Volcano ashfall reach Cebu and how long will it last? Kanlaon Volcano remains under Alert Level 2, indicating increasing volcanic unrest. Several local government units around the volcano urged residents to remain alert and observe safety measures amid the volcanic activity. READ: Volcanic quakes raise […]...
